findings.title: Login redirect/return target not constrained against open redirect
findings.section: U2 — Publish the optional essay and retain navigation
findings.why_it_matters: The plan adds new public navigation paths into and out of the auth flow (landing → Our Vision → return to root). Its return link is hard-coded to `/`, which is safe. But nothing says the restyled login must not accept a caller-supplied post-login destination. Stating that the return link and post-sign-in destination stay fixed internal paths keeps the existing callback URLs (KTD1) from quietly becoming an open redirect during the restyle.
findings.suggested_fix: In U2 Approach step 2, add: the return-to-Nami link and any post-sign-in destination are fixed internal paths; no query-parameter-driven redirect target is introduced.
evidence: Its return link targets `/`, letting the existing route/session behavior choose the destination.
keep `/` session-gated with the existing redirect, pending-session presentation, sign-out behavior and callback URLs

residual_risks: The public essay is rendered with react-markdown from authored content, and the plan forbids raw HTML. Links inside the essay should still get safe attributes if they point to external sites; the plan only specifies safe attributes for the workspace's Our Vision link.
